<title
    level="1"
    right="Feat 2"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Thlipit Contestant Dedication](/Feats.aspx?ID=5474) <actions string="" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Archetype" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=535" />
<trait label="Dedication" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=572" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 74

**Archetype** [Thlipit Contestant](/Archetypes.aspx?ID=224)

**Prerequisites**
You have a long prehensile tongue or a tail. At the GM’s discretion, similar flexible appendages, such as tentacles, can be used to qualify instead.

</column>

---

Grueling practice has strengthened your tongue or tail to the point where it's become a formidable weapon. You gain a lash melee [unarmed](/Traits.aspx?ID=719) attack that is in the [flail](/WeaponGroups.aspx?ID=7) weapon group, deals 1d4 bludgeoning damage, and has the [grapple](/Actions.aspx?ID=2376) and [reach](/Traits.aspx?ID=684) traits. The attack can be performed with any appendages you used to qualify for this feat.

<title level="2">Thlipit Contestant Dedication leads to...</title>
[Fly Swat](/Feats.aspx?ID=5475), [Lassoing Lash](/Feats.aspx?ID=5476), [Levered Swing](/Feats.aspx?ID=5479), [Powerful Lash](/Feats.aspx?ID=5477), [Reflexive Grapple](/Feats.aspx?ID=5483), [Slingshot Maneuver](/Feats.aspx?ID=5482), [Slurp Up](/Feats.aspx?ID=5480), [Snap Falling Fruit](/Feats.aspx?ID=5478), [Spinning Release](/Feats.aspx?ID=5484), [Tail Guard](/Feats.aspx?ID=5481), [Whirling Clobber](/Feats.aspx?ID=5485)
